name: install and configure a zsh framework with a named theme and plugins
definition: Install a shell framework, then configure the user rc file to enable a specific theme and a specific set of plugins by their plugin names.
failure_mode: Plugin or theme not declared / not actually installed, so sourcing fails or lists missing entries.

name: install and invoke the r runtime for an analysis
definition: make the R runtime available and actually run a script so an R session executes over the provided object data.
failure_mode: no R artifacts means the verifier finds no evidence and fails.
